profile.name: Keller Group plc
profile.summary: Keller Group plc provides specialist geotechnical services in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific. The company offers ground engineering solutions, including ground improvement services, grouting, deep foundations, earth retention, marine, and instrumentation and monitoring services, as well as post-tension systems and industrial services. It also provides bearing capacity/ settlement control, low carbon construction, containment, excavation support, stabilization, marine structures, seepage control, slope stabilization, and monitoring solutions. In addition, it provides environmental remediation and demolition. The company provides its services to the construction sector in commercial, industrial, infrastructure, institutional/public buildings, power, and residential markets. Keller Group plc was founded in 1860 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
profile.summary_fr: Keller Group plc fournit des services géotechniques spécialisés en Amérique du Nord, en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie-Pacifique. La société propose des solutions d'ingénierie au sol, y compris des services d'amélioration du sol, de coulis, de fondations profondes, de rétention de la terre, de marine, d'instrumentation et de surveillance, ainsi que des systèmes de post-tension et des services industriels. Il fournit également des solutions de contrôle de la capacité portante et du tassement, de construction à faible teneur en carbone, de confinement, de support d'excavation, de stabilisation, de structures marines, de contrôle des suintements, de stabilisation des pentes et de surveillance.
